brief: Compare account access conditions with a person’s stated device, location and documentation constraints.

title.pt-BR: O acesso precisa servir para você

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Access must work for you"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "El acceso debe servirte"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "O acesso precisa servir para você"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Compare account access conditions with a person’s stated device, location and documentation constraints.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Compare the required device, location and documents with what the person actually has.
instruction.misconception: Assuming a low-cost account is usable despite unavailable devices, inaccessible branches or unmet documentation requirements.
instruction.numeracy_support: The worked examples introduce the required operation; every assessed task retains its own amounts and assumptions.

evidence.reasoning: A low fee is not enough if the required access route is unavailable. Check device, location and documented requirements.
The required device is part of whether the account is usable.
A listed feature is useful only through an accessible route.
Verify permitted alternatives rather than inventing eligibility.
Service speed alone does not solve unavailable connectivity.
Assistance need not mean surrendering private account access.
Access depends on a usable supported verification method.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
